Run if its Green Light

- Collect resources 💎
- Break beds 🛏️

💻 Controls:

- Shift to sprint
- Ctrl to shiftlock
- Hold down left click to auto swing or auto build
- E to open backpack
- V for picture mode

🎮 Console:

- R1: Equip item forward
- L1: Equip item backward
- R2: Activate item
- B: Drop item
- X: Sprint
- Y: Shiftlock
- DPad: Item shop selector / Upgrade selector
- L2: Purchase / Upgrade
